correctness.rationale: Changing variables identifies the operator norm squared with the largest ratio of arcsine L2 measures, original Chebyshev measure versus rescaled subinterval arcsine. At least one endpoint is strictly interior. The Christoffel bound |p(x)|² <= (2N+1)/pi ||p||² and a 1/N endpoint split bound the ratio O(sqrt(N)); a normalized reproducing kernel at an interior endpoint has height squared of order N on a one-sided c/N interval, forcing ratio Omega(sqrt(N)). Thus ||R_N||=Theta(N^(1/4)). Triangular leading coefficients give diagonal 1,alpha,...,alpha^N, and iterates converge at fixed N to evaluation at beta/(1-alpha), yielding exact sqrt(1+2 sum_{j=1}^N T_j(t*)²) power-limit norm. Independently reconstructed finite Chebyshev matrices, computed SVD norms and checked the spectral diagonal; those finite tests do not prove the N-uniform estimates.
residual_risks: Finite computations do not replace the proof.
